images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished ecommerce category artwork for an Israeli workwear shop, one of a coordinated set of nine. Create ONE landscape 3:2 image, edge-to-edge artwork, no mockup. Art direction: premium industrial editorial still life, realistic 3D materials with bold graphic art direction. Restrained palette of warm off-white #F4F4F2, charcoal black #111111, and safety yellow #FFD100. A large saturated yellow circular disc partly behind the hero object, a low matte charcoal rectangular plinth, warm off-white studio background, subtle fine grain and strong directional shadows toward bottom left. Elevated three-quarter camera angle. Large visually striking objects occupy 70-80% of the frame and remain fully visible with at least 8% safe margin. Graphic, crisp, tactile, sophisticated, clean contemporary workwear campaign. Arrange as one cohesive sculptural composition, not a grid. No people, mannequins, skin, text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, watermarks, sale badges, UI, frames or borders. This is a category illustration, not a depiction of a specific branded item. Subject: An oversized white disposable protective coverall, naturally folded with its hood and front zipper recognizable, next to a white pleated disposable face mask, a soft white bouffant hair cap and a neatly arranged pair of white disposable gloves. Crisp lightweight nonwoven fabric textures. A cohesive clean work-hygiene supplies still life on the charcoal plinth, with a large yellow disc behind. No medical symbols, no packaging, no skin or person.
